sentences.en: You should brush your teeth at least twice a day.
sentences.zh: 你应该一天至少刷两次牙。

sentences.en: He brushed up his English during his stay in London.
sentences.zh: 他在伦敦期间把他的英语提高了一下。

sentences.en: If you are going to America, brush up your English.
sentences.zh: 如果你要去美国，最好把你的英语水平提高一下。

phrases.zh: 复习；提高（某方面的技能）
